source: User Charles capture from AVIA VOLT Suisse iOS app
finding: simulate-pricing endpoint returns deterministic connector pricing
interpretation: This endpoint is sufficient to obtain an exact energy price for a specific AVIA connector and indicates whether time-based components exist. It is preferred over reverse-mapping tariffIds when automating national pricing.
remainingGap: Capture the POST request body/query parameters used by the app so the request can be replayed safely and automatically for every AVIA connector.
security: No APIM subscription key or authorization token stored.
